title: Claude Code usage insights
description: Written by the usage-optimizer:report skill from digest.md / metrics.json only (never from session transcripts). Rendered as the report's Insights tab. Check with: python3 scripts/validate.py insights <file> --metrics <out>/metrics.json

generated.description: Local time the insights were written, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM

metrics_generated.description: meta.generated of the metrics.json these insights were written from (the report flags them as stale when it changes)

scope.description: Report scope the insights are about; default "all"

spend_usd.description: Total spend of that scope at API list prices

summary.description: 3-5 sentences: the overall bottom line, cost first

bottom_line.description: One sentence with the key number: what is true and why it matters

detail.description: The reasoning, with numbers from the cited questions

questions.description: Report question IDs (cards) that together support the insight; the first is the main one

scope.description: Scope id when the insight is about one project; the report switches to it

savings.description: Required for category "cost": what applying the change from day one would have saved over the analysed period

usd_so_far.description: The saving over all the analysed days (all time)

usd_per_month.description: The same saving per 30 days: usd_so_far × 30 / days covered

basis.description: How it was computed, naming the question it comes from (usually an SV card)

overlaps_with.description: Insight ids whose savings overlap with this one

optimizations.description: Ids in optimizations.json (added by the optimize skill)
